ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips, 60% low-intensity dark pixels in the central region and inner lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white regions located on the outer 1/3rd of both the left and right lobes. The left lobe exhibits dense dark speckling (mottling) within the white region. The right lobe contains a large white blob intersected by three distinct dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 105 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks localized near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, with a sharp upward taper at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Four isolated circular white dots are visible in the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on the right lobe; several thinner, less-defined diagonal streaks are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; prominent dark rake marks on the right ventral surface.
